exact_alias_rule: The Stage A reference kit's 24 scripted journeys and the tester package's 24 scripted scenarios are packaging/execution representations of IA09-FX-001..024, not forty-eight additional scenarios. They contribute zero additive scenario count.
semantic_overlap_rule: Different stable IDs do not prove nonduplicate coverage. PPIA-15 must compare actor, object, timing, authority, failure mode, recovery path, device/accessibility mode, scale and expected oracle before deciding that a new scenario adds coverage.
secondary_source_rule: PPIA-02 through PPIA-08 completed artifacts may ground a named object-edge case without becoming PPIA-15 dependencies or changing the canonical dependency set.
